{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Rebar → `uStarterBarsRebar`
{{% /callout %}}

Places starter bars for a wall from the foundation or slab, in nine bar types (ss, se, l1, l2, q1, q2, z1, u1, u2) with spacing rules shared with the Border tool. Bars that cannot be spaced as a group fall back to single bars. Foot, hook and U-leg lengths are outside dimensions. The tool passes its native suite (4062 checks) and an end-to-end insert and modify test on Tekla 2026.

<blockquote class="page-note">The Tekla plugin string is <code>uStarterBarsRebar</code>. Components placed by the earlier Clone builds (<code>uStarterBarsRebarClone</code>) may not be recognised by it; see <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">Upgrading from the earlier Clone builds</a>. Sets saved under the earlier dialog name are carried over with the <a href="../rebar-upgrade/">preset migration helper</a>.</blockquote>
